long_description:
The Wedding & Bridal Expo in Hartford is a premier event that showcases a wide range of services and products for couples preparing for their special day. Organized by Jenks Productions, this annual expo is held at the Connecticut Convention Center and attracts over two hundred local and national wedding vendors. Participants can explore a variety of offerings, including wedding dresses, bridal veils, bridesmaid and mother-of-the-bride dresses, wedding planners, floral arrangements, and decorations. The expo is designed to streamline the wedding planning process, allowing busy couples to find all they need under one roof. With multiple options available for each product and service, attendees can choose from various styles and price points to fit their preferences and budgets.

The event features an array of stage shows throughout the day, where attendees can view the latest trends in bridal fashion. Notable exhibitors include Olena’s Bridal Boutique & Alterations, Bella Bridesmaid West Hartford, and The Bridal Salon at Corrine Weddings, among others. Entertainment highlights include performances by talented musicians such as saxophonist Quinn Mitchell and DJs from MNE Events. Attendees will also have the chance to win exciting prizes, including gift certificates for various local services and products. With its reputation as a vital resource for wedding planning, the Wedding & Bridal Expo in Hartford is an essential experience for couples looking to make their wedding dreams a reality.
